# Gotchas

A central checklist of traps. Each item links to the owning doc for detail.

## Generated files — never edit

- `default.project.json` and `sourcemap.json` are generated and gitignored. Run `npm run build:rojo` after adding/removing/renaming any file under `src/`, and on a fresh checkout or after pulling.
- `Packages/` is Wally output. Regenerate with `npm run wally-install` (also creates `sourcemap.json` + package types).
- `src/modules/items/assets.luau` is generated by Asphalt from `assets/**`. Never hand-edit; rerun `asphalt`.

## Naming and realms

- A filename containing `server` lands in `ServerScriptService`; everything else lands in `ReplicatedStorage.Shared`. See [`rojo-mapping.md`](rojo-mapping.md).
- Folder names are PascalCased; a top-level `src/ui/` becomes `UI`, but `src/modules/ui/` becomes `Ui`.
- Basenames `Server`/`Client`/`Utils`/`Types` get the parent folder prefix: `MonetizationServiceUtils`, `RunnerServiceTypes`.
- Networker ids are **not** folder names. `soundService → "SFXService"`, `generalNotificationsService → "UtilitiesService"`, `offlineEarningsService → "OfflineEarnings"`.
- `TutorialRoot` (and other roots) are discovered by module **name containing `root`**; renaming silently unmounts.

## Entrypoints

- Files under `src/services/` are inert until required + initialized in `src/library/Server.server.luau` / `Client.client.luau`.
- Ordering is load-bearing:
  - server: `DataService` → Analytics → Stock → Monetization (+ `productProcessed` wiring) → Profile → …
  - client: `StockServiceClient` **before** `MonetizationServiceClient`; `TutorialServiceClient` before `MountUI()`.
- `initializeOptionalFeature` runs in `task.spawn` + `xpcall`: a failed feature is disabled with a warning, not fatal. Don't lean on optional features being ready synchronously.

## Runner determinism

- Movement is recomputed on both sides from `startClock`, sanitized roster entries, speed, and path. Any change must keep `RunnerUtils`, `RunnerClient`, `RunnerManager`, `RunnerService`, and `PathData` in agreement — see [`runner-simulation.md`](../systems/runner-simulation.md).
- `sanitizeRunners` must run identically on both sides. Each car's lane comes from its stable `id` and its position from its own `phase` — never from array order or roster size.
- A runner's `id` is never reused and never changes on merge (the left input survives): a report or award keyed by an old id can only credit the car it belongs to, or nothing.
- Changing any speed (uniform upgrade/pass, or one car's level) must ship the re-anchored `startClock`/`phase` in the same message as the new speed. Anchors are computed at send time (`_rebaseStartClock`, `_reanchorChangedLevels`) because broadcasts can be delayed by a merge effect — anchoring when the data changes would still jump when the message lands.
- Don't add server per-frame work; the server intentionally has no `Heartbeat`.
- Merge effects pause broadcasts and lap reporting; keep effect durations in sync between `MergeEffects.luau` and `RunnerService`.

## Data and persistence

- `DataTemplate` is a schema: add fields with safe defaults, never rename/remove. The join reconciler only fills missing keys — it never deletes or recomputes derived values.
- `runnerPurchases` is a price index bumped by **every** runner grant (including free ones); `giveExclusiveRunner` is the exception.
- `index` keys are strings, including exclusive ids (`"1001"`).
- Dynamic keys not in the template are still persisted contract: `_codes`, `__gamepasses`, `__oneTimePurchases`, `__purchaseCooldowns`, `__processedPurchases`, `__giftReceiver`.
- Reading `DataService` at module scope can deadlock before `DataService:init()`; do it in `task.spawn` (see `TutorialSlice`).
- Studio uses the `__test__` profile/stock stores, live uses `__production__`.
- `setCrateInQueue` writes laps before crate id on purpose.
- `offlineEarnings*` are intentionally absent from defaults and cleared on logout.

## Monetization

- Product/pass/gift ids must match the Roblox place; prices are not in code.
- Receipt outcomes: `NotProcessedYet` retries forever; returning `false` from a callback is a deliberate soft-fail (`grantRejected`, receipt granted); only the `PurchaseGranted` path reports revenue and skips `adHeartCrate`.
- Callbacks that grant items must be idempotent — records are capped at 50 receipt ids per player.
- Prompt-time stock checks are the gate; consumption never refuses (may oversell).
- Gifts require the receiver to be online; cross-server delivery uses `DataService:sendGlobalMessage("gift", …)`. Gifted one-time products don't mark `__oneTimePurchases` for the receiver.
- Purchase overlays use `Menu.hideOpenMenu` — closing instead of hiding double-fires `OnClose` (offline claim refund/dup risk).
- `getPassOwnshipChanged` is misspelled in code; don't "fix" it without updating callers.

## Crates and stock

- "Block"/"crate"/"lucky block" are the same id space; `luckyBlockInQueue` is a crate id, not a stock key.
- Crate models must be named `tostring(crateId)` under `ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Blocks`.
- Client crate reels are cosmetic; the server decides the winner before the animation.
- `announceDrop` assumes `TextChannels.RBXGeneral` exists (no guard).
- `StockSlice` needs `isSynced` before it can distinguish "no stock data" from "sold out".
- Keep per-crate loot weights summing to 100 so odds read as percentages.

## Analytics

- Marker names and funnel step numbers are frozen dashboard schema; add new names instead of renaming.
- Client analytics input is untrusted and throttled (`0.2` s); never derive revenue from it.
- `ServerStorage.dotenv` (GAMEBEAST_API_KEY, Discord keys) is not versioned; missing keys disable features with warnings.
- Tutorial stages map to funnel steps as `stage + 2`; stages 9 and 12 are intentionally never persisted.

## UI

- Overlays hide menus; only player intent closes them.
- Use `usePx` for sizes; read player data through `GetDataSource`.
- Roots mount by name; `*.story.luau` is excluded from mounting.
- `CratesSlice` uses Charm atoms (consume with `VideCharm`), unlike most slices which use Vide sources.
- Charm deep-freezes atom values **in Studio only** to catch state mutation. `GetDataSource` therefore passes deep copies — never hand Charm a table that DataService still owns, or nested writes like `DataService:set({ "runners", index, "phase" })` fail with "attempt to modify a readonly table" in Studio.

## Content (place-managed)

- `ReplicatedStorage.Assets.*` and `workspace._PLOTS.*` are not in Git. Renaming models/attachments breaks code silently: `Assets.Entities.<id>`, `Assets.Runways.Runway<routeId>` (`waypoints/lane<N>` + `gateAttachments/<id>`), `Assets.Gates.*`, `Assets.Blocks.<crateId>`, `Assets.Tutorial.Arrow`, plot child names (`Spawn`, `RouteSpawn`, `UpgradeTable`, `Buttons.*`, `LuckyBlock.*`, `Sign.PlayerTable`).
- Regular car models are ids 1–40; exclusive ids start at `ID_BASE = 1000` and must be registered in `ExclusiveCars.luau`.
- Adding a trail requires both `Trails.luau` and crate loot entries.

## Economy and tooling

- Income is computed in three places (server payout, client indicator, offline) — update all three.
- The Python simulator in `tools/` is out of sync with runtime formulas; re-derive before trusting results and update both copies when balancing.
- `balance/` is a dated snapshot; don't quote it as current.
- Rebirth wipes cash entirely and resets upgrades; `skipRebirth` does not.

## Repository

- There is no test suite or typecheck script. Verify behavior manually in Studio; use `stylua src` and `selene src`.
- Multiple branches can lag `main`; this docs set describes `main`. Confirm you are on the intended branch before editing (the live place matches `main`).
- `AlgoTips/` is an unrelated, untracked marketing knowledge base with its own `AGENTS.md`; don't mix it into code docs.
